title: anim.ground/1
description: data/anim/ground.json: how World's ground-contact events (docs/world/ground-contact.md section 4) shape the poses (render/anim/anim_fighter.gd, on_ground_event; docs/animation/pose-pipeline.md section 9.18). Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-reference: surface has a multiplier for each of the five surfaces in data/biomes/contact.json (and may add `water`) (checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js, ground-surface; a surface that is livelier than soil on the soft ones, or deader on the hard ones, is a warning, ground-order).

surface.description: A multiplier on the bounce's crumple and pose weight by the surface class (World's bounceMul): paving and rock lively, sand and rubble dead.

ref.description: The speed that gives the pose its full weight.

min.description: The least weight the pose gets.

ref.description: The speed that gives the pose its full weight.

min.description: The least weight the pose gets.

launch.description: The lip launch: the event's spd.

brace.description: The weight of the brace of a tumble (the older spelling of weight).

weight.description: The share of the pose the brace is (about half, so the flail of the ragdoll shows through).

slow_k.description: The multiplier below slow_speed of the landing (firmer at low speed).

fast_k.description: The multiplier above fast_speed of the landing (looser at high speed).

worn_loosen.description: How much a worn fighter loosens it.

worn_from.description: The wear (or brink) above which a fighter counts as worn.

max.description: The cap on the brace weight.

hold.description: The brace of a tumble: in and out times (s), and optionally its weight, speed multipliers, wear loosening and cap.

slow_above.description: The wear (or brink) above which the get-up is the slow one.

brace.description: The brace weight, as a top-level key (also accepted inside hold).
